sentences.text: Call for the record of the trial Court as well as the appellate Court.
Also heard on I.A.No.01/2024, application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the applicants.

This criminal revision has been filed being aggrieved by the judgment of conviction and sentence dated 27-11-2024 passed by the Court of learned First Additional Sessions Judge, Saraipali, District Mohd. Irfan @ Monu vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 5 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130854943/
1 Mahasamund (C.G.) in Criminal Appeal No.10/2023 arising out of the judgment dated 17-08-2023 passed the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class Basna, District Mahasamund C.G. (parties being State Vs. Mohd. Irfan @ Monu and others), whereby the learned appellate Court has maintained the conviction of the applicants under Section 498A/34 of the IPC, and reduced the jail sentence awarded by the learned trial Court to each of these applicants from R.I. for 1 year to R.I. for 6 months and fine sentence of Rs.1000/- and default sentence of 15 days R.I. has also been affirmed by the learned appellate Court.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicants that the applicants were on bail during the trial and they are hopeful to succeed in this revision petition which has been brought for setting aside the judgment of conviction and sentence passed against them.

entities.text: State Vs. Mohd. Irfan @ Monu and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicants have been sentenced with short sentence of six months only and they have already deposited the fine amount imposed upon them.
Therefore, it is prayed that the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail may be allowed.
Learned counsel for the State/respondent opposes the application.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the impugned judgment.

After perusing the judgment impugned and also considering that the short sentence has been awarded to the applicants, I feel inclined to allow the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

Accordingly, I.A.No.01/2024, application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail, is allowed and it is directed that the jail sentence imposed upon the applicants shall remain suspended during the pendency of this criminal revision and they shall be released on bail on each of them furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.5,000/- with one surety each in like sum to the satisfaction of the trial Court for their appearance before the Registry of this Court on 23rd of January, 2025.

They shall thereafter appear before the trial Court on a date to be given by the Registry of this Court and shall continue to appear there on all such subsequent dates as are given to them by the said Court,
till disposal of this criminal revision.
List the matter for final hearing in due course.

Sd/-
(Arvind Kumar Verma) Judge Aadil Mohd. Irfan @ Monu vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 5 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130854943/
